what: Polyphemus the Cyclops, seen close from the chest up in the mouth of his cave above the sea: a huge shaggy giant whose face has no ordinary eyes, where a man's two eyes would be there is only smooth skin; instead one single enormous round eyeball, as wide as half his face, bulges from the middle of his forehead above his nose, wide open, with a white eyeball and a big dark brown iris, under one thick black brow. Long wild black hair and a long matted black beard; a cloak of thick creamy white sheep fleece over his shoulders; a heavy log of grey-brown olive wood resting on his right shoulder as a club. Behind him the dark rock of the cave mouth and, far below, a small black ship with one white sail on a bright blue sea.
colours: Weathered dark sun-browned skin; one huge white eyeball with a dark brown iris; long black hair and beard; creamy white fleece; a grey-brown olive-log club; dark grey cave rock; a bright blue sea and sky; a small black ship with a white sail.
must_show: exactly one huge eye in the middle of his forehead
a shaggy black-bearded giant in white fleece
an olive-log club on his shoulder
a small ship on the sea behind
